adversarial_reasoning.location: reports/current.md:1-275; DGM sections and table, held-out/generalization sections, AlphaEvolve and harness counterexamples
adversarial_reasoning.basis: Read the complete task and complete 275-line current report. Tested whether retained artifacts establish transferable benefit, whether selection tasks masquerade as holdouts, whether positive and negative harness studies are treated as matched experiments, and whether external models and extra search remain visible. Checked DGM original §4.2-4.4 and Appendix C.3 (VSI001 lines 108-129,1028-1038), HarnessPro generated-test/selection/split method (VSI004 lines 278-320), and Rethinking test-access and transfer protocols (VSI003 lines 225-250). The report accurately bounds test-patch exposure, validation selection, held-out task axes, oracle-versus-final results, and the limited negative transfer result. One consequential DGM alternative explanation remains missing: the evolved runtime itself can spend additional attempts and judge-model calls, apart from the disclosed optimization expenditure.

findings.location: reports/current.md:58-62 and comparative matrix DGM row at158; related claim at11
findings.basis: R_TASK requires separating gains from additional search/stronger external models from evidence that the changed system is better. DGM original sources/actual/VSI001.txt:122 explicitly says discovered workflow changes include multiple attempts to solve a task, another foundation model evaluating/selecting the best solution, and conditioning later attempts on earlier ones. The report explains the outside diagnostic model and optimization-run cost, but omits these extra downstream inference/selection operations while interpreting cross-benchmark gains as transferable infrastructure improvements. Transfer rules out simple dependence on the exact search tasks; it does not distinguish better tool design from applying more runtime search and selection to every held-out task. State these documented runtime changes beside the DGM gains, identify whether matched downstream call/token/cost evidence exists, and narrow attribution to the retained whole agent when it does not. This does not erase the measured gains or require a new run; it prevents the reusable-artifact result from being read as isolated evidence of better capability at a fixed inference budget.
